caseName: United States v. Mountain Copper Co.
caseNameFull: United States v. The Mountain Copper Company, Limited

opinions.text: Appeal from the United States Circuit Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit. November 9, 1908. Dismissed per stipulation, on motion of .Mr. Solicitor General Hoyt for the appellant. The Attorney General, The Solicitor General, and Mr. Ligoh Johnson for appellant. Mr. W. S. Goodfellow and Mr. Charles P. Eells for appellee.
